investmentIntelligence.thesis: Mercedes-Benz Places is the only residential address in North America carrying the Mercedes-Benz name, and it sits on one of the last large-scale Brickell sites with direct park frontage and Underline connectivity. The $2B+ project is backed by a $1.06B institutional financing package with BD&T & MSD as anchor lender and Jeff Soffer's Fontainebleau Development entering as equity partner. JDS's track record (111 West 57th, The Brooklyn Tower, Dolce & Gabbana Brickell), combined with SHoP's architecture and Field Operations' park design, makes this one of the most credentialed teams ever assembled for a Miami project. Buyers contracting now hold early pricing across a branded asset that will be impossible to replicate.

investmentThesis: Mercedes-Benz Places is the only residential address in North America carrying the Mercedes-Benz name, sited on one of the last large-scale Brickell parcels with direct park frontage and Underline connectivity. A $1.06B financing package anchored by BD&T & MSD (backed by Byron Trott and Michael Dell) and the entry of Jeff Soffer's Fontainebleau Development as equity partner reflect institutional conviction at a scale rarely seen in Miami pre-construction. JDS Development Group brings direct Miami precedent (Dolce & Gabbana Residences Brickell) alongside a global track record (111 West 57th, The Brooklyn Tower). SHoP Architects and Field Operations add world-class design credibility that cannot be replicated in Brickell.
name: Mercedes-Benz Places
residenceContent:
Two towers rise 67 stories above Brickell, connected by a mid-rise podium that opens to sky on both sides. The silhouette is immediately recognizable from anywhere in the city. Sculpted horizontal fins wrap every floor, catching light and shadow in a rhythm that references the brand without quoting it literally.

Interiors by Woods Bagot move between crisp blacks and whites and warm red oak, with rose gold fixtures running throughout. Up to 10-foot floor-to-ceiling windows open onto 5-foot deep terraces. Kitchens are fitted with a full Miele suite (induction cooktop, convection oven, refrigerator, dishwasher, wine fridge, and speed oven in select residences), set behind tinted etched mirror backsplashes with integrated technology screens. Baths use Duravit throughout, with black or white stone showers, illuminated ledge reveals, and floating walnut vanities.

The amenity program spans over 130,000 square feet. Residents have access to a rooftop pool exclusive to the building, a Silver Arrow Lounge with racing heritage decor, a custom Mercedes-Benz F1 simulator, a recording studio, and a full wellness circuit: saunas, an onsen ritual circuit, Himalayan salt room, aromatherapy room, and steam room. At grade, Field Operations (the firm behind the High Line) has reimagined the nearly 2-acre Southside Park with padel courts, a basketball court, a children's playground, and a direct connection to The Underline.
